layman_headline: Market is hot after a big rally — no great new entries, so we're sitting tight on Solana.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin just surged 13% in a week to nearly $80K and dragged everything up with it. The market mood has shifted to 'Greed,' meaning most coins have already moved a lot. Our Solana position is slightly in profit but still well below its target. The swing trade candidates right now are either wildly overbought (like PUMP with an RSI of 84) or lack solid technical data to justify entry. Chasing rallied coins in a greedy market is how you get caught holding the bag.
layman_action: Keep holding the existing Solana position. The stop-loss at $92 protects downside. Wait for a pullback or clearer setup before adding any new trades.
expert_reasoning: The entire market just ripped higher — BTC +13.2%, SOL +18.6%, XRP +27.2%, ZEC +41.2% in 7 days. Fear & Greed at 71 and trending worse (rising greed) signals elevated correction risk. PUMP has an RSI of 84, making it a clear avoid. POL dropped 12.7% in 24h after a 31% weekly run — classic blow-off. KITE is up 35.7% weekly with zero technical data. MON lacks RSI/MACD data. The stablecoins (USDG, FDUSD, XAUT) aren't swing trade candidates. BTC dominance at 59.1% is unfavorable for alt entries. The prudent move is to hold SOL (0.8% unrealized gain, still early in the trade) and wait for either a market pullback creating better entries or SOL to approach its $115 target. News about potential Fed hike and BTC struggling below $80K add caution.
risk_factors: CoinDesk reports traders betting on a Fed rate hike — if this gains traction, risk assets including crypto could sell off sharply
BTC dominance at 59.1% is squeezing alts; if BTC corrects, SOL could drop faster given its higher beta
Fear & Greed trending toward higher greed levels often precedes short-term market corrections
watch_list: BTC price action around $80K — a decisive break above could extend the rally, rejection could trigger a pullback to $74-75K
SOL approaching $105-110 resistance zone — watch for volume confirmation or rejection
Fed rate expectations — any hawkish surprise would be bearish for all risk assets
market_context: The crypto market is in a strong rally phase with BTC up 13% weekly, but Fear & Greed at 71 (trending higher) and talk of Fed hikes suggest the easy gains may be behind us. High BTC dominance at 59.1% means altcoins are underperforming relative to Bitcoin.
context_banner: Post-rally consolidation phase — protect gains and wait for pullbacks rather than chase extended moves.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 71 and worsening (rising greed) — historically a mixed signal (56% win rate) that suggests caution on new entries.
PUMP RSI at 84 confirms the strongest swing candidate is dangerously overbought, eliminating it from consideration.
Traders starting to bet on a Fed rate hike — a macro headwind that could cap the current crypto rally.
SOL volume at $4.2B is robust and supports the current uptrend, but the 18.6% weekly move may need consolidation.
BTC ETF inflows slowing to $232M as BTC stalls under $80K — potential loss of institutional momentum.
